name: Ernest
source:
Freewheeling minstrel and good friend of the king since his childhood.
Because of his flashy prince-like appearance, he has a lot of fans in the country.
People tend to think of him as a strange man but he is smart and strong.
Actually, he has a mission to do…

"I get you to be my fiancee!"

[From Google Play]
